text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Walls 12 mm, 200 tall: two long walls 314 long, two end walls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 140 long between them. Cavity 290 x 140, open top and bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld outside only; grind the cavity faces flat and square,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: within 0.5 mm; break the top and bottom inside edges 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Belt: 16 x 50 bar round the top, flush with the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side flanges: 16 mm plates 120 x 150 under the belt on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long walls. Before welding, drill 14 and tap M16 in 4 places:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the centre line, 20, 57, 93 and 130 up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge lugs (+X end) and latch lugs (-X end): 20 mm plates on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the belt ends, inner faces 144 apart; 31 holes 37 out from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: belt, 10 above the rim (hinge) and 25 below it (latch).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each lug pair together on a bar so the pins slide in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flanges slide between the column webs (shim to 0.5 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 288 x 138 plate passes through the cavity freely.
